svg.text: Region failure plan for the hub; sweep guarantees convergence after recovery
Audience: SRE / executive | Notation: AWS-style DR | Scope: Hub control plane
Note: Targets: RTO 60 min, RPO 5 min. Loss of events during failover is tolerated: the sweep re-derives all state from cloud APIs.
